in_marathi.name: Dhanraj
in_marathi.long_meaning: Dhanraj हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Dhanraj is a compound name derived from two Sanskrit words: Dhan (wealth, prosperity) and Raja (ruler, king). This name signifies a person is a wealthy and powerful ruler.
